text:
ana: Quick heads-up — Sapphire wants to run a perf/W sweep next week. Need alignment on kernels, driver pins, and telemetry before we hand them the runner. cc @sapphire-eng :wave:

mike: Sounds good. Can we lock the model set? Propose: `redwood/3B-q8`, `open-llama-7B-q4`, `redwood/13B-compat` (to cover small/med/large).

jordan: Also need to pin firmware + driver versions. Sapphire will be on kernel 5.12.7 in the lab; our last internal tests were 5.10.3. Mike/Eva — can you confirm the kernel patchset we require?

eva: I can produce a driver matrix today. Also proposing the bench harness invocation we give partners: 
```
./bench.sh --models redwood/3B-q8,open-llama-7B-q4,redwood/13B-compat \n          --batch 1,2,4,8,16 --seq 512 --power-source pdu --sample-interval 5s \n          --out s3://redwood-bench/sapphire/${RUN_ID}/results.csv
```
This will produce CSVs with columns: model,batch,seq,tokens_per_sec,avg_power_w,tokens_per_sec_per_watt.

sylvia: For perf/W we must standardize the power measurement. Use PDU readings (IPMI) and sample every 5s. Add `--power-offset` to account for baseboard draw. Also require 3 independent runs to compute mean/stdev.

bench-bot: scheduled: nightly-run created -> job id 77821. Artifacts will land at `s3://redwood-bench/sapphire/1783456789/`. Reminder: logs + metrics will be gzipped.

mike: Timeline suggestion: hardware arrives Tue, run Wed–Thu, aggregation Friday. Draft joint blog/press note by Monday; marketing wants embargo until we sign off.

jordan: Who owns the analysis notebook? I can take the analysis and plotting if Eva owns baseline run CSVs. We'll standardize the notebook to accept the CSV schema above.

eva: Taking baseline runs on 5.10.3 now. I'll push raw CSVs + md5sums and a `bench/README.md` with exact commands and environment (`GCC`, `CUDA`, driver versions).

ana: Sorry, typo — ana: marketing flagged a joint-announcement date: 2026-04-10 tentative. Please treat numbers as embargoed until we have partner sign-off.

sylvia: QA checklist: 1) 3 runs per model/batch, 2) kernel `dmesg` capture, 3) `nvidia-smi -q` (or hw-specific telemetry) snapshots, 4) SHA256 of binary artifacts. Add `--smoke` for a quick sanity run.

jordan: Add capture of kernel logs and `sysstat` (iostat/mpstat) during runs — helps correlate perf dips. Put all into the artifact bundle.

eva: I'll add a tiny helper script to collect artifacts: 
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
RUN_DIR=$1
mkdir -p $RUN_DIR/artifacts
dmesg > $RUN_DIR/artifacts/dmesg.txt
nvidia-smi -q > $RUN_DIR/artifacts/gpu_snapshot.txt
ipmitool sensor > $RUN_DIR/artifacts/pdu_sensors.txt
aws s3 cp $RUN_DIR/artifacts s3://redwood-bench/sapphire/${RUN_ID}/artifacts/ --recursive
```
Will commit to the partner repo and to our internal bench repo.

bench-bot: run 77821 report (partial): 13B-compat: 2.8 tokens/s/W, open-llama-7B-q4: 4.1 tokens/s/W, 3B-q8: 6.7 tokens/s/W. These are preliminary; runs still in progress.

mike: Nice. Keep raw CSVs private (partner embargo). I'll draft release notes and coordinate the partner PR + cloud marketplace blurb once we have final numbers.

ana: ana: OK — let's do a quick sync Wed 10:00am (partnerships channel) to review artifacts and decide final publish cadence. I'll invite Sapphire and product-marketing. :calendar:

jordan: ack. I'll prepare the analysis notebook and an initial deck with perf/W charts and methodology slides.

eva: will upload baseline CSVs and the artifact tarball by EOD Thu.

sylvia: I'll run the stdev computations and sanity-check the power traces against PDU logs.

bench-bot: note: artifact retention 30 days for this run. Use `bench-bot archive <job-id>` to extend.

mike: thanks all — see you Wed. :thumbsup:
